name: Mystic Orchard of Anti‑Gravity Apples
description: An orchard where apple trees grow upside‑down, their roots glowing, apples float in mid‑air, each apple emitting a soft pulse of color, a gentle breeze of colored light drifts among them.
prompt: Upside‑down apple orchard with trees rooted from bright glowing clouds, apples levitating in perfect formation, each apple pulsing with soft pastel light, gentle breezes of colored light swirling, magical orchard, surreal, hyperrealistic, twilight sky.
caption: Apples that float like tiny planets 🍎🌈 Wander through an orchard where gravity takes a holiday.
